verdicts.rationale: weaviate_007 is CONFIRMED as a true type coercion defect. The OptionalStringFromMap function in entities/vectorindex/common/config.go (lines 103-106) silently ignores null values when the type assertion value.(string) fails. This causes null inputs for the distance field to be coerced to the default value 'cosine' instead of being rejected with a 422 error.
